brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Three Hex bases clustered (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0) with covers added for desk surface; notch drawer-frame placed at 1,1 (notch:0#1,1#notch2, stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) standing in empty cell beside the two outer bases – provides drawer storage in desk footprint.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) upgraded to mount variant and fitted with platform-sm accessory; verified spike occupies the 3-base corner created by the compact cluster.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-base triangle cluster with top covers forming desk unit. Added notch drawer-frame at 1,1 for drawer storage, and a mount spike at the central three-base junction carrying a small platform (platform-sm). Mesh clash clear, no rule errors.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
